migration.description: Add exec-attempt evidence, early observed thread identity and development baseline to dispatch requests; use persistent native notification claims.
migration.release_unit_description: multi-task-flow source Skill; installation and real-run migration excluded

durable_state.description: JSON ledger operations, immutable requests, events and notification attempts
durable_state.storage_implementation: existing atomically replaced ledger.json and request records

source_compatibility_range.from_program_versions: schema-1 legacy/contract-1 read-only; schema-2 contract-1 read-only; schema-2 contract-2 writable

pause_points: after any durable attempt; unknown retains capacity and forbids blind retry

recovery.faulty_release_recovery: forward-repair-by-a-new-program-version; reuse native request and observed identity; replay never respawns or sends

validation.stopped_release_reentry: unknown dispatch/request replay and SIGKILL notification claim preserve identity and exclude duplicate side effects
validation.public_api_impact: minor: existing creation payload retained; notification-send now prepares a native send intent requiring explicit platform receipt
validation.persistent_state_impact: minor: candidate reads historical evidence; older binaries need not read dispatch_thread_observed and must not be used to continue native dispatches
validation.downgrade: not supported for newly written native dispatch state; no installation or downgrade performed
